Vet student, exotic pet dad, and wildlife traveler in the Philippines 🩺🐊🇵🇭

In this channel, I'll be talking about ALL THINGS ANIMALS! From vlogging my journey in vet school (Vetlog), traveling around the world in search of wildlife (Vet Voyager), sharing tips & tricks to survive vet school (Dissection Kit), and explaining facts about our pets & wildlife (Fauna Fam) - all of my videos will be about how awesome the animal kingdom is!

I also used to host a podcast about Philippine pop culture which you can find on this channel as well. :)

Thanks for your support & let's #MakeAnimalsCoolAgain !
